podcast.title: Evolution of New Wave Synth Pop
podcast.body: By 1984 and 1985, New Wave Synth Pop began morphing into Sophisti-pop, a new blend characterized by soul, cocktail jazz, and lavish production, exemplified by songs like Wham!'s "Careless Whisper" and Sade's "Smooth Operator." "By 1984 and 85, New Wave Synth Pop was morphing into Sophisticop, a blend of soul, cocktail jazz and lavish production."
